race.title: BetMGM Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: HERE COMES GEORGIE proved another fine advert for the sublime training skills of Dan Skelton at Cheltenham recently and can make light of a 7 lb rise for that strong-travelling success. Anthony Honeyball has an excellent recent record in this (when usually at Wincanton) and his Leave of Absence could prove the chief threat and the pick of his quartet. Montregard , Kap Vert and Konfusion all have plenty to recommend them too. HERE COMES GEORGIE LEAVE OF ABSENCE (FR) MONTREGARD (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Here Comes Georgie (5/2), Montregard (5/1), Leave Of Absence (11/2), Kap Vert (15/2), Konfusion (8/1), King Turgeon (12/1), Dartmoor Pirate (14/1), Master Chewy (16/1), Hold Your Fort (16/1), Marble Sands (16/1), Jasmin De Grugy (20/1), Gustavian (25/1)
